correctness.rationale: The exact disconnected-triple partition yields A={h}*Delta_3(C_n) (cone) and B=Delta({1,n−1})*∂Delta({2,...,n−2}) (an m=n−3 dimensional ball). Every submaximal B-face is in A except its two explicitly identified (m−1)-faces; these are distinct free faces paired with different m-facets of B. Their elementary collapses leave contractible B' with m−2 relative m-cells over intersection I; I is (m−2)-connected and has Z^{m−2} top homology. Hurewicz/Whitehead and the cofibration homotopy pushout give A∪B≃ΣI≃∨^{n−5} S^{n−3}. For n=5 there are no surviving top cells and I collapses; a hub dominating all rim vertices makes the intact/rim-edge-deleted complex a cone. Direct independent enumeration of n=5..8 gives expected mod-two Betti and intact/rim-edge comparison; it does not substitute for the all-n integral proof.
